sub_graphs.title: EIP-7569: Dencun Execution Layer EIP Integration
sub_graphs.description: Models how execution layer EIPs are integrated and activated as part of Dencun upgrade

nodes.label: Execution Layer Pre-Cancun
nodes.description: Execution layer operating under Shanghai rules

nodes.label: Activate EIP-1153 Transient Storage
nodes.description: Enable TLOAD and TSTORE opcodes for transient storage operations

nodes.label: Activate EIP-4844 Blob Transactions
nodes.description: Enable type-3 blob transactions and blob gas pricing

nodes.label: Activate EIP-5656 MCOPY
nodes.description: Enable MCOPY opcode for memory-to-memory copy operations

nodes.label: Activate EIP-6780 SELFDESTRUCT Restriction
nodes.description: Restrict SELFDESTRUCT to same-transaction contract destruction only

nodes.label: Activate EIP-7516 BLOBBASEFEE
nodes.description: Enable BLOBBASEFEE opcode to read current blob base fee

nodes.label: Execution Layer Post-Cancun
nodes.description: Execution layer operating under Cancun rules with all new EIPs active

edges.label: At fork block, enable transient storage
At fork block, enable blob transactions

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7569: Dencun Consensus Layer EIP Integration
sub_graphs.description: Models how consensus layer EIPs are integrated as part of Dencun upgrade

nodes.label: Consensus Layer Pre-Deneb
nodes.description: Consensus layer operating under Capella rules

nodes.label: Activate EIP-4788 Beacon Root Access
nodes.description: Enable beacon block root exposure to execution layer via system contract

nodes.label: Activate EIP-7044 Exit Validity
nodes.description: Make signed voluntary exits valid indefinitely regardless of fork version

nodes.label: Activate EIP-7045 Attestation Slots
nodes.description: Expand attestation inclusion window from 1 epoch to full epoch boundary

nodes.label: Activate EIP-7514 Churn Limit
nodes.description: Cap validator activation churn rate to limit rapid validator growth

nodes.label: Consensus Layer Post-Deneb
nodes.description: Consensus layer operating under Deneb rules with all new EIPs active

edges.label: At fork epoch, enable beacon root access
At fork epoch, enable perpetual exit validity
At fork epoch, expand attestation window
At fork epoch, apply churn limit

ambiguities.text: The meta EIP does not specify the exact order in which the execution layer EIPs should be applied within a single block.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume all execution layer changes are applied atomically at the fork block boundary, with no ordering dependencies between individual EIPs.

ambiguities.text: The relationship between execution layer timestamp-based activation and consensus layer epoch-based activation is not explicitly coordinated.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume activation epochs are chosen such that the first slot of the activation epoch corresponds to the expected execution layer fork timestamp.

implicit_assumptions.description: All client implementations have updated to support Dencun before the activation epoch is reached.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Non-upgraded nodes would fork off the canonical chain, causing network partitioning and potential loss of funds for users on the wrong fork.

implicit_assumptions.description: Testnet activations (Goerli, Sepolia, Holešky) serve as sufficient validation before mainnet activation.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Bugs discovered only after mainnet activation could cause consensus failures, requiring emergency intervention.

implicit_assumptions.description: The individual EIPs included in this meta EIP have been thoroughly reviewed for security vulnerabilities.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Security vulnerabilities in any component EIP would be inherited by all networks activating Dencun.
